description: Starts a one-off payment for the full report and ready-to-send replies. The price depends on the amount the points challenge (US$19 / 39 / 59 / 89 in the US for under 300, 300 to 1,000, 1,000 to 2,500 and over 2,500 challenged; A$29 / 59 / 89 / 129 in Australia; £15 / 29 / 45 / 69, C$25 / 55 / 79 / 119 and NZ$29 / 59 / 95 / 149 elsewhere; tax included, one-off, no subscription) and is shown on the report before paying. Returns a secure Stripe checkout link: give it to the user to open and pay themselves (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card). Never ask for card details. After they pay, call get_report to fetch the full report. Only offer it when the user wants the full report.
